Registered firm shou ld submit scanned copy of certificate along with Bid. b) (if not registered) may apply for registration via VRR form with requisite fee s & documents as mandated in the VRR form through the website http://ve ndor.glidersindia.in/. After applying for registration, vendor has to take a print-out of the filled up VRRF & attached with this bid. Application for registration should be applied before tender opening date. 4. PSD-Performance Security Deposit is required@ 5 % of total contract value in the f orm of Account Payee Demand Draft, Fixed Deposit Receipt, Banker's Cheque or B ank Guarantee from any of the commercial Banks in favour of ‘The Chairman & Managing Director, Gliders India Limited, Kanpur’ payable at Kanpur (Validit

y for Bank Guarantee should be 14months and for others validity should be 12 mo nths). PSD will be applicable if contract value exceeds Rs. 10 Lakh. 5.The Firm should comply all the terms and conditions No. OPF/GIL/T&C/01 Rev. No. 0 1 dtd: 16.06.2025 as per attached bid document. If the bidder is not agreed to any agreed to any condition, The Bidder should represent the same in bid otherwise it will be assumed that the participating bidder is agreed to all terms and conditions. 6. If EMD is furnished in the form of BG then it should be kept valid f or 45 days beyond the final bid validity. 7. Firms having same IP address in bid will be rejected/disqualified and no further co mmunication to be made in this regard. 8.
